title.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the concept of local learning applied to neuron groups within neural networks.
title.quote: Traditional deep network training methods optimize a monolithic objective...In this work we propose to study how local learning can be applied at the level of splitting layers or modules into sub-components...

extractions.description: The paper explores the concept of local learning in neural networks by proposing the splitting of layers into neuron groups that each have their own local learning objectives. This approach is intended to enhance parallelization and model-parallel distributed training.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper does not focus on climate or ecological sustainable development thèmes but rather on technical advancements in machine learning methodologies for neural network training.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Traditional deep network training methods optimize a monolithic objective...in terms of how much computation can be distributed...
